Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Applicable 7a. 1. Bidder shall be the Original Manufacturer (OEM) of catalyst utilised for direct Steam reforming of Naphtha for Production of Hydrogen. Bidder shall submit, along with the bid, relevant docume nts like Certificate of Incorporation, valid ISO certifications (ISO 9001/ISO 14001), or any other ce rtificate issued by government body in support of their claim as ‘Original Manufacturer’ of above catalyst. 2. Bidder offered Catalyst (in terms of grades/trade name) for direct steam reforming of naphtha must have been previously supplied to at least one of the Refinery/Petrochemical plants in India/ worldwide in the last Ten (10) years (10 years ending on last date of the month immediately prev ious to the month in which last date of bid submission falls). Documentary evidence in the form o f executed Work Order/ Purchase Orders are to be submitted along with the bid. 3. Bidder offered catalysts (in terms of grades/trade name) must have proven track record with s atisfactory performance. Satisfactory Performance Certificate/letter from at least one customer/ end-user or email from the customer/end-user as documentary evidence is to be submitted along with the bid. If the customer was/is any IOCL Refinery, Bidder need not submit satisfactory certifi cate but need to mention which IOCL refinery, furnish relevant PO details and period of its usage in that refinery. In case, the bidder could not submit Performance certificate from User, they can submit a Self-certificate in support of Satisfactory Performance giving W.O/PO reference, User Or ganisation address, contact details etc. 4. IOCL reserves the right to cross-verify, with the Customer/end-user, the supporting Documents submitted by the Bidder. If claims/documents are found dubious, IOCL- reserves the right to rejec t such bid(s), Commercial Experience PQC: Applicable For experience, the order(s) executed by the bidder, during the last five years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the original bid submission end dat e falls, should be considered as under:- Three orders each executed for “Supply of Steam naphtha reforming catalyst” where executed value is not less than INR 54,85,000.00 OR 7b. Two orders each executed for “Supply of Steam naphtha reforming catalyst” where executed va lue is not less than INR 73,14,000.00 OR One order executed for “Supply of Steam naphtha reforming catalyst” where executed value is not less than INR 91,42,000.00 Note:- Please refer “INSTRUCTION FOR COMPLIANCE OF PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (PQC)” for required documents to fulfil commercial experience PQ Criteria. The life of the catalyst shall be reckoned from the date of 1st feed-in to the date of final discharge from the Reformer. PBG to be extended accordingly.
